name: ryuchi_percussionista_unmasked_idle
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production CHIBI pixel art animation sheet for Torii & Hutukara. Image 1 is the REQUIRED USER STYLE and PROPORTION reference: huge round head, compact tiny torso, VERY SHORT STUBBY LEGS, chunky boots, cute simplified adult face, about 2.2 heads tall. Keep this squat CHIBI silhouette in all poses; NEVER elongated realistic/anime anatomy. Image 2 is costume/instrument reference (Franco synthesizer TOP row, Ryuchi percussionist BOTTOM row). Image 3 supplies facial identity, simplified into the CHIBI style of image 1. Optional image 4 supplies mask geometry.
Exactly EIGHT COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, landscape canvas, 32 full-body poses, ONE hero, ONE action and ONE mask variant per image. Row1 FRONT/down, row2 LEFT profile, row3 BACK/up, row4 RIGHT profile. Each row has eight consecutive temporal poses read left to right: anticipation, action/contact, follow-through, recovery when relevant. Fixed body scale and ground baseline; complete character, instrument, sticks, mask spikes stay inside each equal invisible cell with generous transparent padding. All four rows same scale. Crisp deliberate square 16-bit pixel clusters, dark outline, limited stepped palette. No smooth painting, gradients, blur, 3D rendering, text, labels, grid, floor, shadow or checkerboard. TRUE TRANSPARENT PNG alpha. Costume, head size, instrument and straps stay consistent. Front-mounted keyboard remains on FRONT of torso, naturally occluded in back view; show strap across back, not a keyboard worn on back. Drum stays strapped at waist. Preserve extremely short legs in every pose.
CHARACTER: RYUCHI PERCUSSIONISTA: warm medium skin, strong dark brows, subtle moustache/chin stubble simplified in chibi face, black/dark purple fitted cloth cap with white zigzag and tied cloth at back. Blue-purple quilted technical jacket with gold piping and blue shoulder pads, plum trousers, short dark boots, cyan/magenta headphones. TWO wooden golden drumsticks and strapped electronic waist drum with GOLD ROUND PADS, magenta/cyan rim. Instrument/pad arrangement identical across frames. No katana or bow.
MASK: UNMASKED in every frame: natural face, cap/hair and headphones clearly visible. Ivory spiked mask may be stowed on hip belt as in image1, NEVER worn on face in this sheet.
ACTION: Eight subtly distinct breathing frames. Small chest rise, soft knee weight shift, elbows settle, one blink, neutral face. Ryuchi holds sticks above pads; Franco hands rest over keys. Seamless eighth-to-first loop.
